prompt:
## Resumo
A clean, high-performance CRM

## Estilo Visual
# Handoff prompt — "Leads" CRM screen

**How to use this file:** copy everything below the horizontal rule into your coding agent as a
single message. It is self-contained — the agent needs no Figma access, no screenshots and no
other files. Every number in it has been measured off the source frame and verified in a browser.

---

# TASK

Build a pixel-accurate, responsive recreation of the **Leads** screen of a CRM called Yu Studio.

The source is a Figma frame measuring **1440 × 810**. You are reproducing it exactly — this is a
reproduction task, not a design task. **Invent nothing.** Every colour, size, string and position
you need is in this document. Where a value looks odd (half-pixels, uneven tab padding), it is
deliberate and inherited from the source design; reproduce it as written rather than tidying it.

**Deliverable:** one self-contained `index.html` — Tailwind via CDN for layout utilities, plus a
`<style>` block holding the design tokens, the exact type scale and the responsive rules. Inline
SVG for all icons. No build step, no icon library, no JS framework. A small amount of vanilla JS
only for the mobile navigation drawer.

*(If your project already has a component framework, port the same markup and the same numbers
into it — but keep the `<colgroup>` column model and the media-query rules below verbatim, because
those are exactly where naive rebuilds break. See TRAPS.)*

---

# PART 1 — design.md

## 1.1 Typeface

**Inter only**, weights 400 / 500 / 600:

```html
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
```

On `body`: `font-feature-settings: "cv11","ss01"`, `-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased`,
`-moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale`, `margin: 0`.

Ten styles. The half-pixel sizes come from a ~1.3× source scale and are intentional — **do not
round them**. Line heights are held constant across size changes.

| Class | Weight | Size / line-height | Letter-spacing | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `.text-kpi-value` | 600 | 31.5px / 38px | −0.4px | KPI metric numbers |
| `.text-heading-page` | 600 | 23.5px / 30px | −0.3px | Page title "Leads" |
| `.text-heading-brand` | 600 | 16px / 22px | −0.25px | Workspace name, user name |
| `.text-body-large` | 400 | 16px / 22px | 0 | Secondary count beside a title |
| `.text-body-medium` | 500 | 14px / 20px | −0.25px | Lead names, manager names |
| `.text-body-regular` | 400 | 14px / 20px | −0.1px | Default UI text |
| `.text-body-small` | 400 | 12.5px / 18px | 0 | Keyboard hint, micro copy |
| `.text-label-tab` | 500 | 14px / 20px | −0.15px | Filter tabs |
| `.text-label-score` | 500 | 13px / 18px | 0 | Score badges, count chips |
| `.text-label-caps` | 500 | 12px / 16px | +0.5px, uppercase | Status badges |

## 1.2 Colour

Declare these as CSS custom properties on `:root`.

**Neutral scale**

| Variable | Hex |
|---|---|
| `--color-neutral-0` | `#FFFFFF` |
| `--color-neutral-50` | `#F5F7F9` |
| `--color-neutral-100` | `#EFF1F3` |
| `--color-neutral-200` | `#E2E4E6` |
| `--color-neutral-350` | `#D2D5D9` |
| `--color-neutral-400` | `#9BA0A6` |
| `--color-neutral-600` | `#4E525A` |
| `--color-neutral-700` | `#3B3F4B` |
| `--color-neutral-850` | `#1B1E28` |
| `--color-neutral-900` | `#0D0F14` |
| `--color-neutral-1000` | `#1A1D25` |

**Ink** — the near-black action scale: `--color-ink-900` `#17191F`, `--color-ink-800` `#262A32`.

**Status hue pairs** — `--red-50` `#FDE8E5` / `--red-700` `#B42318` · `--amber-50` `#FBF0DA` /
`--amber-700` `#A66A08` · `--lime-50` `#ECF5DA` / `--lime-700` `#457F19` · `--green-50` `#E2F4E6` /
`--green-700` `#147A3A` · `--green-400` `#07B93B` (online dot).

**Semantic roles** — bind components to these meanings, not to raw hexes:

| Role | Value | Applied to |
|---|---|---|
| bg / canvas | neutral-0 | page background, main column |
| bg / sidebar | neutral-50 | sidebar, row hover |
| bg / field | neutral-100 | inputs and checkboxes **on the sidebar** |
| bg / field-on-canvas | neutral-50 | inputs and secondary buttons **on white** |
| bg / raised | neutral-0 | active nav pill, status badges, count chips |
| bg / primary | ink-900 | primary buttons, checked checkbox, tab indicator |
| bg / primary-hover | ink-800 | primary button hover |
| bg / logo | neutral-1000 | brand mark |
| text / primary | neutral-900 | headings, lead names, manager names |
| text / secondary | neutral-600 | default body copy, table labels |
| text / tertiary | neutral-400 | placeholders, "Plus plan", email line |
| text / on-primary | neutral-0 | labels on near-black |
| border / default | neutral-200 | every hairline |
| border / strong | neutral-350 | status badge outline |
| icon / default | neutral-600 | header and toolbar icons |
| icon / muted | neutral-400 | placeholder icons, row overflow menu |
| icon / strong | neutral-900 | active nav icon, active view toggle |
| chart / line | ink-900 | sparklines |

**Score tiers** — bands are 2 / 3 / 3 / 2 across ten points, so the extremes stay rare:

| Tier | Scores | Background | Label |
|---|---|---|---|
| poor | 1–2 | `#FDE8E5` | `#B42318` |
| fair | 3–5 | `#FBF0DA` | `#A66A08` |
| good | 6–8 | `#ECF5DA` | `#457F19` |
| excellent | 9–10 | `#E2F4E6` | `#147A3A` |

**Trend chips** — up: `#E2F4E6` background, `#147A3A` text *and* icon. down: `#FDE8E5` background,
`#B42318` text *and* icon.

**Discipline:** the screen is near-black-and-white. The *only* colour anywhere is the score badges,
the KPI trend chips and the green online dot. No gradients on surfaces. There is a warm brand
orange in the wider system (`#FF7124`) — it is **reserved and must not appear on this screen**.

## 1.3 Radius

| Token | Value | Applied to |
|---|---|---|
| checkbox | 5px | checkboxes |
| chip | 6px | nav count chips, keyboard hint |
| pill | 7px | status badges, score badges, trend chips, tab count chip |
| control | 10px | buttons, search fields, active nav pill |
| surface | 14px | logo mark |

## 1.4 Elevation

- **Raised** — `0 2px 5px rgba(13,15,20,.08), 0 1px 1px rgba(13,15,20,.05)`. Active nav pill only.
- **Floating** — `0 12px 32px -4px rgba(13,15,20,.22), 0 2px 6px rgba(13,15,20,.10)`. Overlays.

## 1.5 Motion

Restrained. `transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out` on buttons, nav
items, tabs and icon buttons. Row hover is `#F5F7F9`. The mobile drawer slides with
`transition: left 300ms ease-out`. No entrance animations, no parallax, no transforms.

## 1.6 Accessibility

- Real `<table>` / `<thead>` / `<tbody>`, every `<th scope="col">`.
- Real `<input type="checkbox">`, each with a unique `id` and a visually-hidden `<label for>`
  reading "Select all leads" / "Select Emma Johansson" etc.
- `aria-label` on every icon-only button.
- `*:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #17191F; outline-offset: 2px }`.
- Every score tier pair clears 4.5:1 contrast — do not restyle them.

## 1.7 Iconography

25 unique icons from the **Untitled UI line set**. All are **16 × 16**, drawn on a `0 0 24 24`
viewBox, `fill="none"`, `stroke="currentColor"`, `stroke-width="1.5"`, `stroke-linecap="round"`,
`stroke-linejoin="round"`. Colour comes from the parent via `currentColor`.

**Hand-author every one as inline SVG. Do not use an icon font, an icon CDN, emoji or placeholder
boxes.** (A previous attempt used a lucide CDN; several names did not exist and rendered as blank
gaps — `chevron-selector-vertical` in particular.)

`announcement-01` · `bell-01` · `check` · `chevron-selector-vertical` (an up chevron stacked over a
down chevron) · `clipboard` · `dots-horizontal` · `download-cloud-01` · `filter-funnel-01` ·
`grid-01` · `help-circle` · `info-circle` · `list` · `message-text-square-01` · `plus` ·
`search-lg` · `search-md` · `settings-01` · `settings-04` (horizontal sliders) ·
`switch-vertical-01` (up/down arrow pair) · `target-04` · `trend-down-01` · `trend-up-01` ·
`upload-cloud-01` · `user-plus-01` · `users-01`

## 1.8 Components

- **Primary button** — bg/primary, text/on-primary, radius 10, height 38, 12px horizontal padding,
  8px gap, hover bg/primary-hover. Used for *Share* (62 wide) and *Add lead* (102 wide, height 36).
- **Secondary button** — bg/field-on-canvas, text/secondary, radius 10, height 36, 8px left /
  12px right padding, 8px gap. Used for *Import* and *Export* (both 88 wide).
- **Status badge** — hug width, height 23, 8px horizontal padding, radius 7, white fill, 1px
  border/strong hairline, `.text-label-caps` in text/secondary.
- **Score badge** — hug width, height 26, 6px horizontal / 4px vertical padding, radius 7, **no
  border**. Background and label from the matching tier. Reads `n/10` in `.text-label-score`.
- **Nav item** — height 38, 12px horizontal padding, 8px gap, radius 10, 16px icon +
  `.text-body-regular`. Idle: transparent, icon/default + text/secondary. Active: white fill +
  raised shadow + icon/strong + text/primary. Count chip pinned right: 29 × 20, radius 6, white,
  `.text-label-score` in text/secondary.
- **Checkbox** — 18 × 18, radius 5, `appearance: none`, `flex-shrink: 0`. Unchecked: bg/field, no
  border. Checked: bg/primary with a white check mark centred on top. Header checkbox is
  **indeterminate**: bg/primary with a white 10 × 2 horizontal bar.
- **Search field** — radius 10, height 38. Sidebar variant: bg/field, 244 wide, 12px left padding,
  with a 26 × 20 white keyboard chip (radius 6, `.text-body-small`, text/tertiary) holding `/`
  pinned 8px from the right. Toolbar variant: bg/field-on-canvas, 283 wide, 9px left padding, no chip.
- **KPI card** — 290 × 111. Cards 2–4 carry a 1px left divider. Label at 20.8 left / 19.8 top.
  Value row at 53 top. Trend chip beside the value: height 26, radius 7, 16px icon + 8px gap +
  `.text-label-score`. Sparkline 82 × 34 anchored 18.5px from the card's right edge, ~44 from top.

# PART 2 — the exact screen

Root is a horizontal flex: **sidebar 280 fixed** (bg/sidebar, 1px right border/default, full
height) + **main fills the rest** (1160 at a 1440 viewport). Horizontal page padding is 18px in
both regions.

Main is a **zero-gap vertical stack**. Each section owns its own 1px bottom hairline
(border/default) so the stack reads contiguous:

| Section | Height | Hairline |
|---|---|---|
| Header | 67 | yes |
| KPI strip | 112 | yes |
| Tabs | 55 | yes |
| Toolbar | 93 | **no** |
| Table header | 33 | yes |
| Each table row | 61.5 | yes |

The page does not scroll-lock — rows simply continue below the 810 fold.

## 2.1 Sidebar

Inner content column is 244 wide (18px side margins) and starts 19px from the top.

**Brand block** (244 × 48) — a 48 × 48 logo mark, radius 14, fill `#1A1D25`, holding a small white
geometric glyph. 61px from the block's left edge, two stacked lines: **"Yu Studio"**
(`.text-heading-brand`, text/primary) and **"Plus plan"** (`.text-body-regular`, text/tertiary).
A `chevron-selector-vertical` icon in icon/muted pins to the right edge of the 244 column,
vertically centred on the block.

**Search field**, 37px below the brand block — 244 × 38, bg/field, radius 10, `search-lg` icon in
icon/muted, 8px gap, placeholder **"Search"** in text/tertiary, `/` chip pinned right.

**Nav list**, starting 21px below the search field. Items 38 tall, 4px vertical gap:

| Item | Icon | Chip | State |
|---|---|---|---|
| Dashboard | `target-04` | — | idle |
| **Leads** | `user-plus-01` | — | **ACTIVE** — full 244 width, white, radius 10, raised shadow |
| Messages | `message-text-square-01` | **4** | idle |
| Orders | `clipboard` | — | idle |
| Customers | `users-01` | — | idle |
| Feedback | `announcement-01` | **1** | idle |
| Help Center | `help-circle` | — | idle |
| Settings | `settings-01` | — | idle |

**User block**, pinned to the bottom of the sidebar (its top sits at y = 740 in the 810 frame) —
a 40 × 40 circular avatar offset 4px from the left with a bottom-right online dot (14px white ring
around a 10px `#07B93B` fill); then **"Stephen Z."** (`.text-heading-brand`, text/primary) over
**"Stephen@yustudio.design"** (`.text-body-regular`, text/tertiary).

*Avatar and logo glyph are placeholders — use an initials circle ("SZ") on a neutral-200 fill and a
simple white geometric mark. Do not substitute a stock photo or a third-party logo.*

## 2.2 Header (67 tall)

**"Leads"** in `.text-heading-page` / text/primary, 18.6px from the left, vertically centred.
Then a **filling spacer**. Then, flush to the 18px right margin: three 16px icon buttons in
icon/default spaced 22px apart — `info-circle`, `settings-01`, `bell-01` — then a 16px gap, then
the **Share** primary button (62 × 38).

## 2.3 KPI strip (112 tall) — four 290 × 111 cards, dividers on cards 2–4

| Card | Label | Value | Chip | Icon |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | New Leads | **151** | 19% green | `trend-up-01` |
| 2 | Qualified Leads | **59** | 19% green | `trend-up-01` |
| 3 | Avg Response Time | **1h 3m** | 19% green | `trend-up-01` |
| 4 | Hot Leads | **23** | 19% **red** | `trend-down-01` |

Sparklines: irregular polylines, 1.8px stroke in `#17191F`, round caps, over a vertical gradient
area fill fading from ~10% ink to transparent. **Give each SVG its own gradient `id` (g1…g4)** and
make each a *different* shape — cards 1–3 drift upward, card 4 descends. Each area path must close
so it fills only the region **between the line and the bottom edge**.

## 2.4 Tabs (55 tall), content starting 20px from the left

Six tabs, all `.text-label-tab`, sharing the row's full height. The horizontal padding is
deliberately uneven (hand-set in the source) — reproduce exactly, left / right:

`All` 16.6 / 14 · `Favourite` 24.8 / 22.45 · `New` 22.45 / 21.5 · `Assigned to me` 21.5 / 25.45 ·
`Overdue` 25.45 / 22.5 · `Hot` 22.5 / 14

**All** is active: text/primary, followed by a 37 × 26 count chip (radius 7, bg/field-on-canvas,
**"426"** in `.text-label-score` / text/secondary). The five others are text/secondary.

A **2px bg/primary indicator, 89px wide, at x = 20** sits on the section's bottom hairline.
The All tab must therefore measure **exactly 89px**: 16.6 padding + "All" + a 4.4 gap + the 37 chip
+ 14 padding.

## 2.5 Toolbar (93 tall — 29 top / 26 bottom padding, no hairline)

Left, at x = 18: the 283 × 38 toolbar search field. Then a 22px gap, then three 16px icon buttons in
icon/default spaced **42px apart** — `filter-funnel-01`, `switch-vertical-01`, `settings-04`.

Then a **filling spacer**.

Right, flush to the 18px margin: two view-toggle icons **36px apart** — `list` (active, icon/strong)
and `grid-01` (idle, icon/default) — then a 24px gap, then three buttons 12px apart: **Import**
(secondary, `upload-cloud-01`), **Export** (secondary, `download-cloud-01`), **Add lead**
(primary, `plus`).

## 2.6 The table

Ten columns. Table header labels are `.text-body-regular` in **text/secondary** (not uppercase).
Header row 33 tall; body rows 61.5 tall; each with a 1px bottom hairline that spans the **full
width**, edge to edge, while content stays inset.

**Column model — use this `<colgroup>` verbatim.** The 19px left and 18px right page padding are
folded *into* the first and last column widths; this is the single most important number set in the
document (see TRAP 1):

| 9 | Created | 125px | 0 | 1001 |
| 10 | Actions | **34px** | `padding-right: 18px; padding-left: 0` | 1126 |

The nine fixed columns total **948px**, so at a 1160px main column Email resolves to exactly

Cells centre their content vertically and align left. The Score cell's 3px top padding compensates

**Header row** — the Select cell holds the **indeterminate** checkbox. Then: Customer, Company,

**Body — 11 rows.** Rows 4, 7 and 8 (**William Lee, Lily Walker, James Young**) are selected: their

# PART 3 — how to build it, in order

Work in this sequence. Each step is verifiable on its own, and the order front-loads the decisions
that everything else depends on.

**Step 1 — Shell and tokens.** Write the `:root` custom properties, the ten typography classes, the
shadow classes and the focus-visible rule. Build the root flex row: `<aside>` at 280 fixed and
`<main class="flex-1 min-w-0">`. Confirm at 1440 that main computes to exactly **1160**.

**Step 2 — Icons.** Author all 25 inline SVGs *before* laying out sections, so no section is built
around a placeholder. Keep them as small reusable snippets. Render them once on a scratch page and
look at them — a wrong-but-present icon is harder to spot later than a missing one.

**Step 3 — Sidebar.** Brand block → search field → nav list → user block. The active Leads pill is
the only white surface here; everything else is transparent on bg/sidebar.

**Step 4 — Main sections top to bottom:** header, KPI strip, tabs, toolbar. Each is a fixed-height
flex row with a **filling spacer** (`flex-1`) between the left and right clusters — that spacer is
what keeps the right-hand buttons flush to the 18px margin at any width. Do not use absolute
positioning or fixed left offsets for the right clusters.

**Step 5 — The table.** Build the `<colgroup>` first, exactly as specified, then `<thead>`, then the
11 `<tbody>` rows. Give the scroll wrapper a class you can target (`.table-scroll-container`) and
the table a `min-width: 1160px` class (`.table-min-width`) — both are needed in Step 7.

**Step 6 — Verify desktop before going responsive.** See PART 5. Do not move on until every column
offset matches. A geometry error fixed now is one fix; fixed after the responsive layer exists, it
is four.

**Step 7 — Responsive, in four bands.** Everything below is scoped inside a media query; **nothing
at ≥1280px may move by a single pixel.**

- **≥1280px** — the frame exactly as specified above.

- **1024–1279px** — shell unchanged, sidebar still 280. The table region scrolls horizontally
  inside its own container so no column crushes:
  ```css
  @media (max-width: 1279px) {
    .table-scroll-container { overflow-x: auto; }
    .table-min-width { min-width: 1160px; }
  }
  ```
  Also in this band: reduce the toolbar's 42px and 36px icon gaps to **20px** so the left and right
  clusters cannot collide, and let the tabs row and the KPI strip scroll horizontally with the
  scrollbar hidden (`scrollbar-width: none`, `::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none }`).

- **768–1023px** — the sidebar collapses to a **72px icon rail**. Icons only: hide nav labels,
  count chips, the brand text, the chevron, the `/` chip and the user's name and email. Centre the
  logo mark, the avatar, each 40 × 38 nav item and a 40 × 38 icon-only search button. The active
  Leads item keeps its white pill and raised shadow. The width override **must out-specify
  Tailwind's `w-[280px]` utility** — see TRAP 2:
  ```css
  @media (min-width: 768px) and (max-width: 1023px) {
    #sidebar.sidebar-collapsed {
      width: 72px !important; min-width: 72px !important; max-width: 72px !important;
    }
  }
  ```

- **<768px** — the sidebar moves off-canvas behind a hamburger button added at the **left of the
  header**; the three header utility icons hide so the title and Share still fit. The KPI strip
  becomes a scroll-snapping row of 290px cards. The table scrolls horizontally with **Select and
  Customer sticky-left** over an opaque white background.
  ```css
  @media (max-width: 767px) {
    #sidebar { position: fixed; left: -280px; top: 0; bottom: 0; z-index: 50;
               transition: left 300ms ease-out; }
    #sidebar.active { left: 0; }
    .kpi-scroll { overflow-x: auto; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; }
    .kpi-card   { scroll-snap-align: start; }
    .sticky-col-1 { position: sticky; left: 0;    z-index: 20; background: white; }
    .sticky-col-2 { position: sticky; left: 66px; z-index: 20; background: white; }
    tr:hover .sticky-col-1, tr:hover .sticky-col-2 { background-color: #F5F7F9; }
  }
  ```
  **`left: 66px` on the second sticky column, not 47px** — it must match the *first column's box
  width* from the colgroup (which includes the 19px padding), otherwise Customer overlaps Select by
  19px the moment the table is scrolled.

  Drawer JS: toggle `.active` on the sidebar, keep `aria-expanded` in sync on the button, render a
  dismissable overlay behind it, and close on `Escape`.

**Step 8 — Verify all four bands.** PART 5 again, at 1440, 1100, 900 and 500.

---

# PART 4 — TRAPS

Five specific ways this build goes wrong. Each was hit and fixed in a previous attempt; the fixes
are already folded into PART 2 and PART 3, but read them so you understand *why* those numbers are
what they are.

**TRAP 1 — Padding on cells while the colgroup ignores it.** The intuitive build puts
`padding-left: 19px` on the first cell and `padding-right: 18px` on the last, and sets the colgroup
to the *content* widths (47 … 16). With `table-layout: fixed` the padding then sits *inside* those
widths, every column drifts right, and the Actions column is pushed clean off the right edge — the
overflow menu icons get clipped. **Fold the padding into the first and last column widths
(66 and 34) as specified.** That is what makes Email resolve to exactly 212.

**TRAP 2 — The tablet sidebar refuses to collapse.** `.sidebar-collapsed { width: 72px }` loses the
cascade to Tailwind's `w-[280px]` utility, so the sidebar keeps its 280px box and merely hides its
labels — leaving a dead gutter and shoving main content off screen. Raise specificity
(`#sidebar.sidebar-collapsed`) **and** use `!important` on `width`, `min-width` and `max-width`.

**TRAP 3 — The classic flex `min-width` overflow.** The table carries `min-width: 1160px`. Because
flex items default to `min-width: auto`, `<main>` stretches to 1160 instead of letting the table's
own scroll container do the scrolling — so on mobile the header stretches with it and the Share
button lands off screen. Put **`min-width: 0` on `<main>` and on every flex wrapper between main and
the table**, and add `overflow-x: hidden` on `body` as a backstop. Only `.table-scroll-container`
may scroll horizontally.

**TRAP 4 — Buttons wrapping.** "Add lead" breaks onto two lines around 1100px. Give every button
and its label `white-space: nowrap` and `flex-shrink: 0`.

**TRAP 5 — The tabs row wrapping.** "Assigned to me" breaks to two lines on narrow viewports and
"Overdue"/"Hot" become unreachable. Below 1280 make the tabs row a `flex-wrap: nowrap` horizontally
scrollable strip with `white-space: nowrap` on each label and the scrollbar hidden. The 2px active
indicator stays pinned under the All tab and scrolls with it.

---

# PART 5 — acceptance checklist

Do not report the build complete until every line passes. Measure — do not eyeball.

**Geometry at 1440 × 810.** Main computes to **1160**. In the first body row, each cell's content
must land at exactly these offsets from the left edge of main:

```
Select 19 · Customer 66 · Company 221 · Email 370 · Status 582
Manager 712 · Source 832 · Score 927 · Created 1001 · Actions 1126
```

The Email column measures **212**. The Actions icon is **fully visible**, 18px from the right edge.
`document.documentElement.scrollWidth` equals the viewport width — no horizontal overflow.

Verify with a probe rather than by looking:

```js
const M = document.querySelector('main').getBoundingClientRect().left;
const expected = [19, 66, 221, 370, 582, 712, 832, 927, 1001, 1126];
document.querySelector('tbody tr').querySelectorAll('td').forEach((td, i) => {
  const c = td.querySelector('input, div, span') || td;
  const delta = Math.round(c.getBoundingClientRect().left - M) - expected[i];
  console.log(i, delta === 0 ? 'OK' : 'DRIFT ' + delta);
});
```

**Content.** 11 body rows. All 11 names present, David Ramirez included. Exactly 3 checked
checkboxes (rows 4, 7, 8) plus 1 indeterminate in the header. All four KPI values and both trend
directions correct.

**Structure.** One `<table>`, one `<colgroup>` with 10 `<col>`, 10 `<th scope="col">`, 110 `<td>`,
12 `<tr>`. Zero references to any icon CDN or icon font. 25 distinct inline SVG icons, all rendering
(scan for blank gaps). No orange anywhere.

**Responsive.** At 1440 / 1100 / 900 / 500 the sidebar is 280 / 280 / 72 / off-canvas. At every one
of those widths: nothing is clipped, no button wraps, no two clusters overlap, and only the table
scrolls horizontally. At 900 the icon rail shows centred icons with the active Leads pill intact.
At 500 the hamburger, "Leads" and Share are all fully visible; the drawer opens, traps nothing,
and closes on Escape.

> **Verification note:** headless Chrome on macOS clamps the viewport to a **500px minimum**
> regardless of `--window-size`. A 375px screenshot is a 375-wide crop of a 500-wide layout, so
> right-edge elements look clipped when they are not. Trust `window.innerWidth` and
> `getBoundingClientRect()` over the image.

# TASK

Build a pixel-accurate, responsive recreation of the **Leads** screen of a CRM called Yu Studio.

# PART 1 — design.md

## 1.1 Typeface

**Inter only**, weights 400 / 500 / 600:


`-moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale`, `margin: 0`.

Ten styles. The half-pixel sizes come from a ~1.3× source scale and are intentional — **do not
round them**. Line heights are held constant across size changes.

| Class | Weight | Size / line-height | Letter-spacing | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `.text-kpi-value` | 600 | 31.5px / 38px | −0.4px | KPI metric numbers |

## 1.2 Colour

Declare these as CSS custom properties on `:root`.

**Neutral scale**

| Variable | Hex |

| `--color-neutral-900` | `#0D0F14` |
| `--color-neutral-1000` | `#1A1D25` |

**Status hue pairs** — `--red-50` `#FDE8E5` / `--red-700` `#B42318` · `--amber-50` `#FBF0DA` /
`--amber-700` `#A66A08` · `--lime-50` `#ECF5DA` / `--lime-700` `#457F19` · `--green-50` `#E2F4E6` /
`--green-700` `#147A3A` · `--green-400` `#07B93B` (online dot).

**Semantic roles** — bind components to these meanings, not to raw hexes:

| Role | Value | Applied to |

| bg / sidebar | neutral-50 | sidebar, row hover |

| chip | 6px | nav count chips, keyboard hint |

items, tabs and icon buttons. Row hover is `#F5F7F9`. The mobile drawer slides with

**Hand-author every one as inline SVG. Do not use an icon font, an icon CDN, emoji or placeholder

`switch-vertical-01` (up/down arrow pair) · `target-04` · `trend-down-01` · `trend-up-01` ·
`upload-cloud-01` · `user-plus-01` · `users-01`

## 1.8 Components

- **Primary button** — bg/primary, text/on-primary, radius 10, height 38, 12px horizontal padding,
  8px gap, hover bg/primary-hover. Used for *Share* (62 wide) and *Add lead* (102 wide, height 36).
- **Secondary button** — bg/field-on-canvas, text/secondary, radius 10, height 36, 8px left /
  12px right padding, 8px gap. Used for *Import* and *Export* (both 88 wide).

  border/strong hairline, `.text-label-caps` in text/secondary.

# PART 3 — how to build it, in order

Work in this sequence. Each step is verifiable on its own, and the order front-loads the decisions
that everything else depends on.

**Step 1 — Shell and tokens.** Write the `:root` custom properties, the ten typography classes, the
shadow classes and the focus-visible rule. Build the root flex row: `<aside>` at 280 fixed and
`<main class="flex-1 min-w-0">`. Confirm at 1440 that main computes to exactly **1160**.

**Step 2 — Icons.** Author all 25 inline SVGs *before* laying out sections, so no section is built
around a placeholder. Keep them as small reusable snippets. Render them once on a scratch page and
look at them — a wrong-but-present icon is harder to spot later than a missing one.

**Step 3 — Sidebar.** Brand block → search field → nav list → user block. The active Leads pill is
the only white surface here; everything else is transparent on bg/sidebar.

**Step 4 — Main sections top to bottom:** header, KPI strip, tabs, toolbar. Each is a fixed-height
flex row with a **filling spacer** (`flex-1`) between the left and right clusters — that spacer is
what keeps the right-hand buttons flush to the 18px margin at any width. Do not use absolute
positioning or fixed left offsets for the right clusters.

**Step 5 — The table.** Build the `<colgroup>` first, exactly as specified, then `<thead>`, then the
11 `<tbody>` rows. Give the scroll wrapper a class you can target (`.table-scroll-container`) and
the table a `min-width: 1160px` class (`.table-min-width`) — both are needed in Step 7.

**Step 6 — Verify desktop before going responsive.** See PART 5. Do not move on until every column
offset matches. A geometry error fixed now is one fix; fixed after the responsive layer exists, it
is four.

**Step 7 — Responsive, in four bands.** Everything below is scoped inside a media query; **nothing
at ≥1280px may move by a single pixel.**

- **≥1280px** — the frame exactly as specified above.

- **1024–1279px** — shell unchanged, sidebar still 280. The table region scrolls horizontally
  inside its own container so no column crushes:
  ```css
  @media (max-width: 1279px) {
    .table-scroll-container { overflow-x: auto; }
    .table-min-width { min-width: 1160px; }
  }
  ```
  Also in this band: reduce the toolbar's 42px and 36px icon gaps to **20px** so the left and right
  clusters cannot collide, and let the tabs row and the KPI strip scroll horizontally with the
  scrollbar hidden (`scrollbar-width: none`, `::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none }`).

- **768–1023px** — the sidebar collapses to a **72px icon rail**. Icons only: hide nav labels,
  count chips, the brand text, the chevron, the `/` chip and the user's name and email. Centre the
  logo mark, the avatar, each 40 × 38 nav item and a 40 × 38 icon-only search button. The active
  Leads item keeps its white pill and raised shadow. The width override **must out-specify
  Tailwind's `w-[280px]` utility** — see TRAP 2:
  ```css
  @media (min-width: 768px) and (max-width: 1023px) {
    #sidebar.sidebar-collapsed {
      width: 72px !important; min-width: 72px !important; max-width: 72px !important;
    }
  }
  ```

- **<768px** — the sidebar moves off-canvas behind a hamburger button added at the **left of the
  header**; the three header utility icons hide so the title and Share still fit. The KPI strip
  becomes a scroll-snapping row of 290px cards. The table scrolls horizontally with **Select and
  Customer sticky-left** over an opaque white background.
  ```css
  @media (max-width: 767px) {
    #sidebar { position: fixed; left: -280px; top: 0; bottom: 0; z-index: 50;
               transition: left 300ms ease-out; }
    #sidebar.active { left: 0; }
    .kpi-scroll { overflow-x: auto; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; }
    .kpi-card   { scroll-snap-align: start; }
    .sticky-col-1 { position: sticky; left: 0;    z-index: 20; background: white; }
    .sticky-col-2 { position: sticky; left: 66px; z-index: 20; background: white; }
    tr:hover .sticky-col-1, tr:hover .sticky-col-2 { background-color: #F5F7F9; }
  }
  ```
  **`left: 66px` on the second sticky column, not 47px** — it must match the *first column's box
  width* from the colgroup (which includes the 19px padding), otherwise Customer overlaps Select by
  19px the moment the table is scrolled.

  Drawer JS: toggle `.active` on the sidebar, keep `aria-expanded` in sync on the button, render a
  dismissable overlay behind it, and close on `Escape`.

**Step 8 — Verify all four bands.** PART 5 again, at 1440, 1100, 900 and 500.

# PART 4 — TRAPS

Five specific ways this build goes wrong. Each was hit and fixed in a previous attempt; the fixes
are already folded into PART 2 and PART 3, but read them so you understand *why* those numbers are
what they are.

**TRAP 1 — Padding on cells while the colgroup ignores it.** The intuitive build puts
`padding-left: 19px` on the first cell and `padding-right: 18px` on the last, and sets the colgroup
to the *content* widths (47 … 16). With `table-layout: fixed` the padding then sits *inside* those
widths, every column drifts right, and the Actions column is pushed clean off the right edge — the
overflow menu icons get clipped. **Fold the padding into the first and last column widths
(66 and 34) as specified.** That is what makes Email resolve to exactly 212.

**TRAP 2 — The tablet sidebar refuses to collapse.** `.sidebar-collapsed { width: 72px }` loses the
cascade to Tailwind's `w-[280px]` utility, so the sidebar keeps its 280px box and merely hides its
labels — leaving a dead gutter and shoving main content off screen. Raise specificity
(`#sidebar.sidebar-collapsed`) **and** use `!important` on `width`, `min-width` and `max-width`.

**TRAP 3 — The classic flex `min-width` overflow.** The table carries `min-width: 1160px`. Because
flex items default to `min-width: auto`, `<main>` stretches to 1160 instead of letting the table's
own scroll container do the scrolling — so on mobile the header stretches with it and the Share
button lands off screen. Put **`min-width: 0` on `<main>` and on every flex wrapper between main and
the table**, and add `overflow-x: hidden` on `body` as a backstop. Only `.table-scroll-container`
may scroll horizontally.

**TRAP 4 — Buttons wrapping.** "Add lead" breaks onto two lines around 1100px. Give every button
and its label `white-space: nowrap` and `flex-shrink: 0`.

**TRAP 5 — The tabs row wrapping.** "Assigned to me" breaks to two lines on narrow viewports and
"Overdue"/"Hot" become unreachable. Below 1280 make the tabs row a `flex-wrap: nowrap` horizontally
scrollable strip with `white-space: nowrap` on each label and the scrollbar hidden. The 2px active
indicator stays pinned under the All tab and scrolls with it.
